editBody: Choose one relation to see on the map.
reviewBody: Review only what will change before writing Markdown.
relationHelp: This becomes one typed line in the Markdown. Folder validation reports a line whose target no document here answers to: it warns, it does not block the write.
targetHelp: Only documents already in this folder can be picked, so the line always resolves. An impact query follows only “{relations}” lines when it answers what a change to this concept reaches.
whyHint: Add the reason when you know it so the next person does not have to infer the line.
whyRequiredHint: A dependency needs a reason for relying on the target.

relationHint.dependsOn: this concept needs it to work

saveError: Could not write. Check whether the file changed, then try again.
noChanges: Nothing changed. Update the relation or its reason first.
